summary: Frontend-only verification of Airbnb-style compact mobile nav (iteration 31). All 8 requested checks passed on the live preview URL. Mobile home nav non-scrolled = 95px (<=100), scrolled = 81.5px (<=85). Mobile stays nav non-scrolled = 103px (<=105), scrolled = 81.5px (<=85). Stays/Services svg icons: 1 before scroll, 0 after scroll (>40px), on both Home and Stays. Logo height collapses to 40px on mobile, retains 200px on desktop home initial / 60px on desktop scrolled. Search bar never overlaps nav. Routing nav-category-stays-mobile -> /stays and nav-category-services-mobile -> /services works. Calendar/WhenPicker regression OK: opens with Dates|Flexible toggle, 2-month grid, range selection updates trigger label to 'Jul 15 - Jul 20'.

issues: Active Stays tab text color computed = rgb(26,26,26) (dark), not gold (#D4AF37). The spec mentioned 'gold underline AND gold text color'. Gold underline IS rendered correctly (border-bottom: 2px solid rgb(212,175,55)). This may be intentional on the white-bg state but worth confirming with design.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm with design whether active tab text on /stays mobile should be gold (#D4AF37) instead of #1A1A1A — underline is gold, text is dark gray.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation.js has two scroll listeners (homeScrolled effect + mobileScrolled effect). Consider merging to a single scroll handler to reduce listener overhead, though both are passive so impact is negligible.
Navigation.js is 725 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Could be split into Navigation, NotificationsDropdown, and MobileMenu submodules.

Mobile scroll effect (line 283-288) runs on EVERY page including desktop viewports where the bottom strip is hidden — wasted state updates on desktop. Could be gated by a matchMedia check, but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 spec checks pass; 1 minor design observation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 verified the compact mobile nav (Airbnb style). Key measurements captured: Home mobile nav 95px initial / 81.5px scrolled; Stays mobile nav 103px / 81.5px; Desktop unchanged (192px home-hero, 68px scrolled/non-home). The mobile bottom strip data-testid is 'nav-rental-categories-mobile' with children 'nav-category-stays-mobile' / 'nav-category-services-mobile'. svg count inside each is the cleanest signal of icon hide/show (1 before scroll > 40px, 0 after). Calendar uses data-testid 'when-trigger-mobile' and trigger label is 'When' + range like 'Jul 15 - Jul 20'.
